text: Plan: batch 1 is a broad probe of canonical cross-sectional families (momentum across horizons, reversal, vol, skew, kurt, beta, corr, max-min proximity, MA ratio) using raw features. Since the portfolio is cross-sectional rank weighted and dollar neutral, SR of neg(x) equals minus SR of x, so raw probes reveal the right sign cheaply. Later batches refine the strongest families with vol scaling, ts_z, horizon neighbors, and combos; final picks favor families whose strength is consistent across neighboring lookbacks (robustness proxy for OOS transfer), not the single max train SR, to limit selection overfitting.

text: Findings: four robust orthogonal effects in train - (1) 250d long-term reversal net of 40d momentum, robust to delay 20 and to maxr or ts_z reformulations; (2) 3d short-term reversal, best normalized by ts_z over 20d; (3) vol term structure sub(std(60), std(10)), i.e. long assets whose recent 10d vol sits below their 60d vol; (4) 250d return skewness with positive sign, strongly persistent - delayed 20 to 40d versions score higher than fresh, and weight in composites saturates near 3x. Equal-risk cs_z composites of these legs reach train SR 1.9-2.0 with IC about 0.010, stable across roughly 25 structural perturbations (leg swaps, neighbor lookbacks, weight changes), which argues the family is not a selection artifact. A beta-corrm-vol level family (train SR 0.7-0.8) was dropped from finals: it carries a directional high-beta tilt whose sign likely depends on holdout market drift, and it diluted composites. Final three are structurally varied members of the validated composite family rather than three copies of the single top scorer, hedging specification risk while keeping expected OOS SR high.

rationale: All three are cs_z-weighted composites of four independently validated effects: 250d long-term reversal net of 40d momentum (2x weight), 3d short-term reversal z-scored over 20d, vol term structure long low recent 10d vol vs 40-60d vol, and persistent positive 250d skewness taken with a 20d delay (2-3x weight). Each leg was separately confirmed with positive standalone SR, neighbor-lookback consistency, and delay persistence; the composite family scores train SR 1.9-2.0 with IC near 0.010 and varies less than 0.15 SR across some 25 structural perturbations. The three picks vary the implementation of each leg (vol leg at 40 vs 60d, reversal core as ret250 minus ret40 vs separate reversal and momentum legs, skew weight 2x vs 3x) to hedge specification risk while staying inside the strongest validated family.
